name: Demo Request
description: Invite a prospect to book a product demo.
html_content:
Hi {first_name},

Based on what your team is working on, I think a quick demo of {company_name} could be useful — especially around {pain_point}.

It's a 20-minute walkthrough, tailored to how you'd actually use it. No slides, no fluff.

Here are a few times that work this week:

  • Tuesday at 10:00 AM
  • Wednesday at 2:00 PM
  • Thursday at 11:00 AM

If none of those work, just reply with what does and I'll find something else.

Thanks,
{sender_name}
